d.ko: A story-driven Metroidvania where the allies you choose to bond with change how you fight and explore. Journey through the high-fantasy world of Raoah, uncover lost civilizations, and forge bonds that shape your path through a land on the brink of collapse.
d.en: A story-driven Metroidvania where the allies you choose to bond with change how you fight and explore. Journey through the high-fantasy world of Raoah, uncover lost civilizations, and forge bonds that shape your path through a land on the brink of collapse.
d.zh: 《陨世之泪：涅槃》完美融合了类银河战士恶魔城的探索玩法与JRPG的叙事魅力，为你带来酣畅淋漓的战斗体验、精妙的平台跳跃挑战，以及一个随着你的抉择而不断变化的世界。
